hero-description: End-to-end, from concept to product — AI-powered applications, full-stack solutions, and intelligent systems.
about-subtitle: Ideas come to life as impactful products, from web and app development to AI applications.
projects-subtitle: Real products, including web, mobile, and AI applications, have been built and shipped from concept to deployment.
contact-subtitle: Building an AI product? Let's discuss how we can work together.
no-projects: No projects found in this category.
404-description: The page you are looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.
cv-mobile-info: Download uses the site server (reliable). Open in new tab shows the file in your browser.
contact-success: Thank you! Your message has been sent.
admin-confirm-delete: Are you sure you want to delete this item?
admin-no-skills-hint: No skills yet. Click "{{add}}" to get started.
admin-confirm-delete-message: Are you sure you want to delete this message? This action cannot be undone.
admin-no-cv-hint: No CV files uploaded yet. Upload a PDF to get started.
admin-hero-title-hint: The title is split into two lines automatically. Use short, impactful text.
admin-firebase-not-connected-warning: Firebase is not connected. Changes will not persist until Firebase is synced.
admin-firebase-connected-desc: Real-time sync is active. Changes are saved to Firebase automatically.
admin-firebase-offline-desc: Working offline. Data changes will sync when connection is restored.
admin-log-empty-hint: Actions will be logged here automatically
admin-media-storage-desc: Images and PDFs are stored in Firebase Storage. Realtime Database keeps only text and download URLs for fast page loads.
admin-media-inline-count: {{count}} item(s) still use embedded base64 in the database. Run migration once to move them to Storage.
admin-media-all-storage: All media uses Storage URLs. No migration needed.
admin-migrate-media-hint: Run once after upgrading. Requires admin login. Deploy storage.rules to Firebase first (firebase deploy --only storage).
admin-migrate-success: Media migrated to Firebase Storage. Site data is now lightweight.
admin-migrate-failed: Migration failed. Check console and Storage rules.
admin-auth-required-upload: Sign in to the admin panel before uploading.
admin-import-inline-hint: Imported data contains embedded images. Use “Migrate embedded media” in Settings.
admin-content-not-loaded: Content and private drafts have not finished loading. Reconnect and try again.
admin-err-accent: Enter a six-digit hex colour, such as #458c8c.
admin-err-slug: This address is already used by {{title}}.
admin-err-url: Links must use a valid http:// or https:// address.
admin-media-alt-required: Add English alternative text for every published media item.
admin-media-bad-type: Unsupported file type. Choose an accepted image, video or PDF.
admin-media-cleanup-failed: Saved, but {{count}} unused files could not be removed. Retry from Settings.
admin-media-none: No media yet. Add authentic product images or diagrams.
admin-media-too-large: This file exceeds the {{mb}} MB limit.
admin-missing-tr: Turkish is empty; English will be shown as a fallback.
admin-not-authorized-body: This account does not have the admin claim. Ask the site owner to provision access.
admin-permission-denied: Permission denied. Check your admin access and Firebase rules.
admin-preview-read-only: Preview is read-only. Changes cannot be saved.
admin-profile-featured-count-hint: Choose 0 to {{max}}. Zero hides the featured stack.
admin-profile-intro: Manage public identity and presentation. Biography is in About; contact, social links and CV have their own editors.
admin-profile-photo-fallback: Default photograph is used until you upload one.
admin-profile-pillars-hint: Leave empty to use the default structure based on your published technologies.
admin-proj-art-hint: Used only when product screenshots are unavailable.
admin-proj-presentation-hint: Reusable layouts adapt to the uploaded media. Auto selects a suitable layout.
admin-proj-previous-slugs-hint: Comma-separated former slugs permanently redirect to the current address.
admin-proj-sections-hint: Add verified context, decisions, implementation details and lessons. Omit unverified outcomes.
admin-proj-slug-changed: The previous address will redirect to this one after saving.
admin-proj-status-hint: For example: Prototype, In progress, Shipped. Use verified status only.
admin-vis-draft-hint: Only admins can read this record. Uploaded media URLs are not private.
admin-vis-published-hint: Visible on public pages, search and the assistant.
admin-vis-archived-hint: Accessible by URL, but excluded from listings, search and the assistant.
admin-timeline-invalid: Enter a title and valid dates (end must not precede start), and use an http(s) URL.
admin-orphan-hint: Scans published content and private drafts. Only uniquely named managed files older than 24 hours are candidates. Legacy files are never selected.
admin-orphan-confirm: Permanently delete {{count}} selected files? References will be checked again before deletion.
admin-orphan-failed: The scan or cleanup could not finish safely. No uncertain candidates were deleted. Reconnect and retry.
admin-orphan-done: Cleanup finished. {{count}} files could not be deleted or are now referenced.
admin-import-confirm: Replace all content, including private drafts, with this backup? Export a backup first.
admin-cv-language-hint: The selected document is the default. The site uses a matching English or Turkish document when available. Select a document to prefer it within its language.
